sections.title: Return Eligibility
content: Products are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery if they are defective, damaged, or not as described.
Certain categories like innerwear, cosmetics, and personalized items are not returnable.

sections.title: Return Process
content: Go to ‘My Orders’, select the item you wish to return, and initiate a return request.
Our logistics partner will arrange for pickup, or you can ship the product to the address provided.

sections.title: Refund Timelines
content: Once the returned item is inspected and approved, refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
Refunds will be made to your original payment source or Shopizen wallet.

sections.title: Exchange Policy
content: If you prefer an exchange instead of a refund, select the ‘Replace Item’ option while initiating a return request.
